abstract: This paper reports on the antitumor activity of BS RNase on human melanoma and mouse seminoma. Human melanoma cells established in culture were extremely susceptible to BS RNase, administered in concentrations ranging from 1-100 microg/ml. Concentrations of BS RNase over 10 microg/ml caused complete inhibition of cell growth. Bovine pancreatic ribonuclease (RNase A), a prototype of the ribonuclease superfamily, did not exert any effect under these conditions. Based on our previous results, athymic mice bearing human melanoma or mouse seminoma were treated with intratumoral administration of BS RNase (12.5 mg/kg b.w.). This dose was injected for five consecutive days excluding weekends. The intratumoral administration of BS RNase to nude mice bearing human melanoma showed a significant antitumor effect. There were no tumors seen in eighty percent of mice treated for three weeks, and tumors in the other mice diminished significantly. After some delay the tumors started to regrow. Prolonging of the treatment to five weeks had a similar effect. The effect of BS RNase on mouse seminoma was well pronounced. Five to seven doses of BS RNase were sufficient to eliminate tumors in all treated mice. However, as in the previous experiment, the growth of tumor tissue later reappeared.
abstract_ja: 本論文は、ウシ精液リボヌクレアーゼ（BS RNase）のヒト黒色腫およびマウスセミノーマに対する抗腫瘍活性を報告する。培養ヒト黒色腫細胞はBS RNaseに極めて感受性が高く、1～100 µg/mlの濃度で用いた。10 µg/mlを超える濃度で細胞増殖は完全に抑制された。ウシ膵臓リボヌクレアーゼ（RNase A）はこの条件下で何の効果も示さなかった。前回の結果に基づき、ヒト黒色腫またはマウスセミノーマを担がんした無胸腺マウスに、BS RNase（12.5 mg/kg体重）を腫瘍内投与した。この用量を週末を除く5日間連続で投与した。ヒト黒色腫を担がんしたヌードマウスへの腫瘍内投与は有意な抗腫瘍効果を示した。3週間治療したマウスの80%で腫瘍は消失した。その他のマウスでは腫瘍は著明に縮小した。一定期間後、腫瘍は再増殖を始めた。治療期間を5週間に延長しても同様の効果であった。マウスセミノーマに対するBS RNaseの効果は顕著であった。5～7回の投与で、治療したすべてのマウスの腫瘍が消失した。しかし前回の実験と同様に、腫瘍組織は後に再出現した。
